question: How is the six-limb set completed and which Sakala group is named?
premises: The six limbs are head, tuft, armor, eye, weapon, together with the heart from the previous verse.
The Sakala group includes Sakala, Akala, Shunya, Kaladhya, Kha, and Kshapana as the last.
inference: The verse completes the sixfold limb set and enumerates the eightfold Sakala group.
uncertainties: The exact count alignment between the listed names and the eightfold group is compressed.
plain_english: They declare the six limbs to be head, tuft, armor, eye, and weapon, together with the heart. Along with them are Sakala, Akala, Shunya, Kaladhya, Kha, and Kshapana as the last.
